  <meta name="theme-color" content="#07131b"/>
  <meta name="description" content="禁忌之书：22张洛夫克拉夫特主题大阿卡纳，抽牌仪式与神话调查档案。"/>
  <title>禁忌之书 · 克苏鲁塔罗</title>
  <style>:root{color-scheme:dark;--bg:#07121b;--panel:#0e202a;--panel2:#102530;--line:rgba(203,164,102,.3);--gold:#c7a66d;--goldlight:#f1d7a1;--cream:#eee5d4;--soft:#a3b0b3;--green:#6f9291;--danger:#e3ab91;--serif:"Baskerville","Iowan Old Style","Songti SC","STSong","Noto Serif CJK SC",Georgia,serif;--sans:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei",sans-serif}
*{box-sizing:border-box}html{scroll-behavior:smooth}body{margin:0;min-height:100vh;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 75% -15%,#143443 0,transparent 46%),radial-gradient(ellipse at 15% 80%,#102b30 0,transparent 42%),var(--bg);color:var(--cream);font-family:var(--sans);-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;overflow-x:hidden}button,input,textarea{font:inherit}button{cursor:pointer}button:disabled{opacity:.52;cursor:not-allowed}a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}a:focus-visible,button:focus-visible,input:focus-visible,textarea:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--goldlight);outline-offset:4px}::selection{background:#8e7549;color:white}.ambient-glow{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:-1;pointer-events:none;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent 0%,rgba(43,91,95,.05) 46%,transparent 100%)}.site-header{height:84px;max-width:1480px;margin:auto;padding:0 5.7%;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:42px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(211,175,110,.14)}.brand{display:flex;gap:13px;align-items:center;white-space:nowrap}.brand-mark{color:var(--gold);font-size:32px}.brand strong{display:block;font-family:var(--serif);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:5px;font-size:22px}.brand small{color:var(--gold);font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:3px}.top-nav{margin-left:auto;display:flex;gap:31px;align-items:center}.top-nav a{font-size:13px;color:#b6b9b0;transition:color .2s}.top-nav a:hover,.top-nav a.active{color:var(--goldlight)}.header-side{font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:11px;color:var(--gold);white-space:nowrap;letter-spacing:2px}.header-side span{margin-left:12px}.bottom-nav{display:none}#app{min-height:calc(100vh - 84px);max-width:1480px;margin:auto;padding:0 5.7% 95px}h1,h2,h3,p{margin-top:0}h1,h2,h3{font-family:var(--serif);font-weight:500}h1{font-size:clamp(44px,6vw,86px);line-height:1.18;letter-spacing:4px}h2{font-size:clamp(32px,3.8vw,54px);line-height:1.2}h3{font-size:clamp(23px,2.8vw,34px)}.eyebrow{font-family:Georgia,var(--serif);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:3px;color:var(--gold);text-transform:uppercase}.subtext{color:#b0bec0;font-size:15px;line-height:1.95;max-width:620px}.hairline{height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,var(--line),transparent);margin:36px 0}.muted{color:var(--soft)}.symbol{font-family:Georgia,serif;color:var(--gold);letter-spacing:8px}.btn,.outline-btn,.text-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:14px;border-radius:3px;padding:16px 25px;font-size:14px;letter-spacing:2px;transition:background .2s,transform .2s,color .2s;text-align:center}.btn{border:1px solid #c6a16a;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#d5b883,#b18b51);color:#101d23;font-weight:650;box-shadow:0 8px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.15)}.btn:hover{background:#e1c58f;transform:translateY(-2px)}.outline-btn{border:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--goldlight);background:#0e222b9c}.outline-btn:hover{background:rgba(201,161,100,.13)}.text-btn{border:0;background:transparent;color:var(--goldlight)}.btn-row{display:flex;gap:15px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:28px 0}.btn.small,.outline-btn.small{padding:10px 15px;font-size:12px}.btn.wide,.outline-btn.wide{min-width:250px}.tag{display:inline-block;padding:6px 10px;border:1px solid var(--line);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:1.5px;color:var(--goldlight);border-radius:30px}.glyph{color:var(--gold);font-family:Georgia,serif;letter-spacing:4px}.smallcap{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:2px;color:var(--soft)}
/* landing */
.hero{min-height:min(770px,calc(100vh - 100px));display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.05fr 1fr;gap:4vw;align-items:center;position:relative}.hero-copy{position:relative;z-index:2;padding:52px 0}.hero-copy h1 .gold{color:var(--goldlight)}.hero-copy .divider-star{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:15px;margin:35px 0;color:var(--gold)}.divider-star:after{content:"";height:1px;width:130px;background:var(--line)}.hero-cards{position:relative;height:650px;display:grid;place-items:center;perspective:1000px}.hero-halo{position:absolute;width:660px;height:660px;max-width:100%;border-radius:50%;border:1px rotate(-13deg);background-image:url('data:image/webp;base64,');opacity:.8}.hero-card.right{transform:translate(54px,22px) 25px 85px #000b,0 0 40px #b69a5333}.hero-orbit{position:absolute;bottom:10px;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:5px;color:#bdaf96}.home-columns{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:24px;padding:36px 0 18px}.home-column{border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding-top:21px}.home-column span{font-family:Georgia,serif;color:var(--gold);font-size:23px}.home-column strong{display:block;margin:15px 0 6px;font-family:var(--serif);font-size:19px;font-weight:500}.home-column p{font-size:12px;line-height:1.8;color:var(--soft)}
/* general */
.page-intro{padding:64px 0 28px}.page-intro h1,.page-intro h2{margin:14px 0 12px}.page-intro .subtext{max-width:750px}.panel{border:1px solid var(--line);background:linear-gradient(150deg,rgba(17,38,48,.93),rgba(7,20,27,.8));padding:26px;border-radius:6px}.panel.soft{background:rgba(12,28,37,.55)}.section-sub{color:var(--gold);font-size:12px;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase}.stats-strip{display:flex;gap:28px;flex-wrap:wrap;font-size:12px;color:var(--soft);padding:16px 0}.stats-strip b{color:var(--goldlight)}
/* codex */
.codex-header{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:end;gap:30px}.search-input,.question-input{background:rgba(5,14,20,.6);border:1px solid #6d644d;border-radius:4px;color:var(--cream);padding:15px 18px;width:100%;outline:none}.search-input::placeholder,.question-input::placeholder{color:#7f969b}.search-input{max-width:300px}.codex-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr));gap:30px 24px;padding:22px 0 70px}.codex-card{display:block;text-align:left;border:none;background:none;padding:0;color:inherit;position:relative;min-width:0;transition:transform .3s ease}.codex-card:hover{transform:translateY(-8px)}.codex-card .art-shell{display:block;box-shadow:0 11px 28px #0008;border:1px solid #867046;border-radius:7px;overflow:hidden;background:#17252a}.codex-card img{display:block;width:100%;aspect-ratio:9/16;object-fit:cover}.codex-card .under{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-top:12px;font-size:12px;color:#d6cbb3}.codex-card .under small{font-family:Georgia,serif;color:var(--gold);font-size:11px}.codex-card .under .name{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:15px}.empty{color:var(--soft);padding:50px 0}.detail-head{display:flex;gap:16px;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:38px 0 12px}.detail-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(260px,.73fr) minmax(340px,1.2fr);gap:clamp(28px,6vw,100px);align-items:start;padding:18px 0 80px}.detail-image{width:min(100%,430px);border:1px solid #c6a16a;box-shadow:0 35px 85px #000b;border-radius:8px;display:block;margin:auto}.detail-content{padding:12px 0}.detail-content h1{font-size:clamp(42px,5vw,64px);margin:15px 0}.detail-content .en{font-family:Georgia,serif;letter-spacing:3px;color:var(--gold);font-size:14px}.detail-content p{line-height:1.9;color:#c9d0ce}.keyrow{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:12px 0 26px}.info-section{margin:28px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding-top:22px}.info-section h3{font-size:22px;margin:0 0 10px}.info-section h3 .glyph{font-size:15px}.info-section p{font-size:14px}.pager{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;margin:30px 0}
/* ritual */
.ritual-screen{max-width:1020px;margin:auto}.progress-track{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:12px;margin:14px 0 45px;flex-wrap:wrap}.progress-track .here{color:var(--goldlight);border-color:var(--gold)}.ritual-modes{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:20px;margin:22px 0 28px}.mode-card{min-height:180px;padding:25px 16px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:#0c222c;color:var(--cream);text-align:center;border-radius:5px;transition:transform .2s,border-color .2s}.mode-card:hover,.mode-card.chosen{border-color:var(--gold);transform:translateY(-3px);background:#142c33}.mode-card .mode-icon{display:block;color:var(--gold);font-size:32px;margin-bottom:19px}.mode-card strong{display:block;font-family:var(--serif);font-size:23px;font-weight:500}.mode-card 10px}.question-input{min-height:92px;resize:vertical;line-height:1.75}.ritual-stage{text-align:center;margin:18px auto solid #8d704c42;box-shadow:0 0 70px #16445a42;z-index:-1}.altar-card{width:170px;max-width:41vw;aspect-ratio:9/16;box-shadow:0 25px 50px #000a;background:url('data:image/svg+xml;base64,') center/cover;border-radius:9px}.altar-card.shuffle-animation{animation:shiver .5s ease-in-out 2}.cut-cards{display:flex;gap:17px;justify-content:center;margin:40px img{transform:translateY(-10px)}.fan-scroll{display:flex;justify-content:center;overflow:visible;padding:50px 18px 45px;margin:auto;max-width:100%}.fan-card{width:clamp(67px,10.5vw,122px);height:auto;aspect-ratio:9/16;border:1px solid #b79b68;border-radius:5px;padding:0;flex:0 0 .22s;position:relative;transform:rotate(var(--rot));touch-action:manipulation}.fan-card:first-child{margin-left:0}.fan-card img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;border-radius:5px;display:block;pointer-events:none}.fan-card:hover,.fan-card:focus-visible{transform:translateY(-23px) rotate(0deg);z-index:30}.fan-card:disabled{opacity:.24;filter:grayscale(1)}.picked-progress{margin:12px 0;color:var(--gold);font-size:13px;letter-spacing:1px}.reveal-area{display:grid;place-items:center;min-height:375px;margin-top:18px}.flip-card{width:185px;max-width:55vw;aspect-ratio:9/16;perspective:1200px;position:relative}.flip-inner{width:100%;height:100%;position:relative;transform-style:preserve-3d;transition:transform .flip-inner{transform:rotateY(180deg)}.flip-side{position:absolute;inset:0;backface-visibility:hidden;-webkit-backface-visibility:hidden;border-radius:9px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid img{transform:rotate(180deg)}.status-chip{display:inline-flex;gap:7px;align-items:center;font-size:12px;color:var(--gold);padding:7px 12px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:99px;margin:12px h3{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:18px;margin:14px 0 3px}.reading-card p{font-size:12px;color:var(--soft)}.reading-panel{text-align:left;max-width:800px;margin:32px auto;padding:24px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:linear-gradient(150deg,#142a32aa,#0b1922)}.reading-panel h3{font-size:26px;color
